item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hey hey!

I'm stormmageexpert (he/him/his). I'm a sophomore in college from Northern California, US, though I go to school in Connecticut. I'm headed to med school if I can swing it, and to linguistics fieldwork if I can't, though that all feels very far away and my day to day life at this point mostly consists of slaving over physics problems and playing Skyrim for too many hours in a row.

I'm mostly signing up so I can upvote, but I have a draft in a sandbox that I might work on more, or not, and I might get active in the fora, or not. I've been a big fan of this site for a while now, and I'm excited to be a member!

As for the QOTM, I'm probably earth, because I value being grounded in my own self and I can be really inflexible, even when it would probably be a good idea to be.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hey guys it's Triangleclipse. I'm so excited that I have been accepted into the SCP foundation. I plan to make hundreds of new SCP's in my time here and I hope to be able to improve this sight in many ways. I also hope to learn about all the different SCP's that all of you worked so hard to create. I joined this site because I felt that I would find people that were like-minded to me and also so that I could create creatures in a community setting. This is something that I have always wanted to do. I think that Earth represents me the most because I feel that I am stable and well-grounded in my life and I am not afraid to stick up for what I believe. I love to draw, read, and write. (Hense the reason I joined this site). I also like to play board games and hang out with friends.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello! You can refer to me as Archivist Tündér or just Tündér [TOON-dair].

I was introduced to the SCP Foundation over the past few months from multiple writer and other creative friends, and have been exploring the universe via various Youtube channels such as SCP Animation, The Exploration Series, and TheVolgun. I've joined the wiki in the hope of writing some SCP articles, adding additional testing ideas to existing SCPs, eventually creating some tales surrounding the character Archivist Tündér and their role within the Foundation. I'm excited to expand my writing style with some of the different formats used across the wiki.

Question Answer: Water because it signifies change, a tempestuous nature, and the eventual breaking down of things once considered to be incapable of erosion.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Greetings, my real name will be redacted for anonymity purposes; but you can call me Dr. Recoil instead. I joined this site because I wanted to read and write skips, and stories about the SCPverse as well.

I've always have an interest in writing and creating my own fictional world with great themes ever since I was young, and after discovering this modern day - internet equivalent of Lovecraft's works just last year, that interest/another hobby of mine has just grown ten folds.

Since we're already talking about hobbies, I would like to mention that I love playing video games and actual ones as well; such as chess. I also have a amateur-ish skill when it comes to video editing.

I would also like to mention that I am not very flexible with English yet at leas, since I am still a student and from a different country as well. Just a heads up in case someone ask me in the future about any possible mistakes in any of my post in the site (though, I'll certainly make sure that that won't frequently happen in my stories here).

Anyways, that's all I have to say. I am looking forward on working with you guys, and once again, thanks for accepting me.

P.S. The element I chose to associate with myself is Air , due to it being virtually invisible unless it decided to make it's presence known, by either helping you breathe or creating strong winds kinda edgy, I know. but that's the way it is ¯\_(ツ)_/¯. Also for the fact that it can be extremely flexible in finding a way out when contained.

item.content:encoded:
Hi I'm DreadinD, you can call me D for short. I'm new and just stumbled upon this foundation by accident on Facebook and I've only known about the SCP's this month and yet despite that, I already have an idea running through my head.

I have an experience in writing, despite English not being my first language, in fact I'm an author at wattpad though not that yet well known, some people like my work. I've joined the SCP Foundation because I find all of the SCP awesome, and it seems to be one of the best place to let my mind run wild, as I happened to have an wild mind both figuratively and literary, that it even makes me afraid of heights even in truth I'm not afraid of it, by making me have thousands of thought on how I could die in high places ,weird, I know.

I like reading stuff as long as its interesting, I even make my own characters to get my mind to calm down (I have enough superhero character to make a series like the Avengers tho the low quality version of it.).

And last, I want to be here to get to know the SCPverse more, to share my ideas, and to get more experience in writing.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Hello H7Kharifel!

Welcome to the site as an official member! We're happy to have long time lurkers join, so now you can vote on all the content you would like to. I'll leave you with my reading list to hopefully help you navigate through the rabbit hole that is this site! Thanks for sharing with us, hope you enjoy your time here!

+Here are some places to start.
-Hope this helps!

Maybe you've already seen these before, maybe you haven't, but hopefully something here is of use to you. Of course, if you have any questions, feel free to reach out!

The newest, freshest material can be found on the Most Recently Created page. If that updates a little too frequently for you though and you want more of a look at what remains popular, you can also try the Top Rated New Pages.

If you want to see what other folks in the community like, there's the User-Curated Lists. Here you can find things the community has put together and deemed a good read. Or maybe you want to give some underrated articles some love? Try out the Underread and Underrated page.

Enjoy large hubs and working your way through them? Some cool hubs include the Guide Hub for things that cover the Site itself, Site News Hub for updates on all sorts of monthly Site content, Canon Hub for all the various canons, GoI Format Hub for all your GoI needs, and Tales Hub for your favorite tales.

Finally, if you find an author you love from any of this and want to see more from them, you can find them in the Authors' Pages section. If they're not on that list, try the statistic site, scpper.com.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everybody,

my name is Paul and I'm very happy i finally registered here. Since 2014 I'm a big fan of the SCP-Foundation. At first I was pretty anxious about joining the site because I'm kind of insecure when it comes to writing online, mostly because I'm born in Germany and I'm unsure about my english. That's why I am pretty unsure about what to do here. I got a few ideas for SCP's, but the texts i wrote are only in german, and I lost my folder 3 days ago with most of my prototype texts in it. I've written them by hand, so i guess they are gone forever, but i would pay a lot to see the look in the eyes of a person who found a folder with texts in the SCP-Style in them not knowing the foundation at all.
Anyway, I am super happy I joined this site (A big thank you again to Zyn he helped me :D ) even if I dont exactly know what I'm going to do.

Please correct me if I made any grammar or spelling mistakes, I alway try to improve my english,
and have a nice evening,
Paul

Heya Four!

Welcome to the site! There's a lot of talented artists who make SCP content - if you like animations, there's a few YouTubers who create them such as Lord Bung, but also some animators here on the site you can find by going through the various art pages! Regardless though, joining the site so you can rate and review skips is a great reason to join, and you're right that there's absolutely no rush to write anything just yet. A great place to start is right where you said - reading - in order to learn what skips do well, what aspects you like, and what you'd like to accomplish in your own skips. item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Hello Hinroe!

Welcome to the site! There's a lot of great content creators over on YouTube, I'm glad one of them could inspire you to come join the site itself! And I would personally love to see some more tale writers as well, I think there's a lot of unexplored content that can be covered in tales that skips have a harder time approaching! Focusing on the personal aspects of the MTF units sounds like a great place to start, I wish you the best and have left you some writer's resources to help you get started. Keep in mind to work at whatever pace works best for you, and that there's no rush to contribute. All that being said though, I hope you enjoy your time here on the site!

+A gift of resources just for you
-Hope this helps!

Maybe you've already seen these before, maybe you haven't, but hopefully something here is of use to you. Of course, if you have any questions, feel free to reach out!

First off, there are some required readings for all site authors. Consider giving them a read, as well as all the other helpful guides on this Guide Hub. The more familiar you are with the processes that take place on the Site, the better your chances of success are!

Now that that's done - Got an idea? Or maybe a few? You can create a Sandbox page to store all your ideas and drafts in an orderly fashion.

Okay, but maybe you're not sure if your concept is ready to be fleshed out, or perhaps it just needs some heavy refinement. If that's the case, you can run things by the community in the Ideas and Brainstorming forum.

Once you believe you have a solid draft, you can go ahead and make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Keep in mind though you should check the stickied posts first on how best to use each of the forums.

Best of luck writing!
